description: Creates a security group (a firewall for the machines you attach it to) and returns its id and the rules it starts with: every outbound connection allowed, nothing inbound. Add inbound rules with add_security_group_rule, then attach it to machines with set_instance_security_groups. Names are unique in your account, because a machine's groups are set by name. Security groups are free. Zero trust: open only the ports a service needs, from the narrowest source that works: another security group (remote_group_id) for your own machines, an address range for people or partners, 0.0.0.0/0 only for a public website's 80/443.

description.description: Optional: what the group is for.

name.description: A name that says what the group lets in, e.g. 'web-public' or 'db-from-app'. Unique in your account; 'default' is taken.

name: create_security_group
title: Create security group
